SELECT COUNT(IN_TB.EMP_NO) FROM ( WITH DEP_TB AS( SELECT UP.DEPT_CD AS DEPT1_CD ,UP.DEPT_NM AS DEPT1_NM ,IN_TB.DEPT_CD AS DEPT2_CD ,IN_TB.DEPT_NM AS DEPT2_NM ,IN_TB.END_YMD FROM ( SELECT DEPT_CD ,DEPT_NM ,UP_DEPT_CD ,END_YMD FROM KYERP.TB_HR_DEPARTMENT@DL_ONTIC WHERE END_YMD ='99991231' )IN_TB ,KYERP.TB_HR_DEPARTMENT@DL_ONTIC UP WHERE UP.DEPT_CD = IN_TB.UP_DEPT_CD AND UP.END_YMD ='99991231' ), INFO_TB AS( SELECT X.EMP_CD AS EMP_NO ,X.EMP_NM /*이름*/ ,DEPT_CD /*팀코드*/ ,MOBILE_NO /*핸드폰*/ ,DEPT_DUTY AS DEPT_GRADE_CD ,KYERP.FN_GET_CM_CODE_NM@DL_ONTIC('HR0003', DEPT_DUTY, 'KO') AS DEPT_GRADE_NM ,E_MAIL FROM KYERP.TB_HR_EMPLOYEE@DL_ONTIC X ,(SELECT A.EMP_CD ,DEPT_CD ,DEPT_DUTY FROM KYERP.TB_HR_PERS_APPOINTMENTS@DL_ONTIC A ,(SELECT DISTINCT EMP_CD, MAX (DOCUMENT_NO) AS DOCUMENT_NO FROM KYERP.TB_HR_PERS_APPOINTMENTS@DL_ONTIC GROUP BY EMP_CD ) B WHERE A.EMP_CD = B.EMP_CD AND A.DOCUMENT_NO = B.DOCUMENT_NO ) Y WHERE X.EMP_CD = Y.EMP_CD ) SELECT DEP_TB.* ,INFO_TB.* ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY INFO_TB.EMP_NO ) AS RNUM FROM DEP_TB, INFO_TB WHERE 1=1 AND DEP_TB.DEPT2_CD = INFO_TB.DEPT_CD
AND UPPER(INFO_TB.EMP_NM) LIKE '%'|| UPPER(#{search_text}) ||'%'
ORDER BY 1 )IN_TB

ORDER BY 1 )IN_TB WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY RNUM DESC

) SELECT DEP_TB.* ,INFO_TB.* ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY INFO_TB.EMP_NO ) AS RNUM FROM DEP_TB, INFO_TB WHERE 1=1 AND DEP_TB.DEPT2_CD = INFO_TB.DEPT_CD AND INFO_TB.EMP_NO = #{emp_no} ORDER BY 1
